packages.name: @decantr/essence-spec
packages.summary: Essence schemas, validation, migration, and TypeScript types.

packages.name: @decantr/registry
packages.summary: 3.x compatibility package for registry-named schema exports, API clients, resolver types, and legacy content utilities. New integrations should prefer @decantr/content for the official corpus.

packages.name: @decantr/content
packages.summary: Canonical Decantr corpus, schemas, provenance, search, resolution, discovery, ranking, and wiring helpers for stack-agnostic AI frontend governance.

packages.name: @decantr/css
packages.summary: Legacy optional CSS atom runtime retained for compatibility and showcase demos; no longer the default greenfield adoption path.

packages.name: @decantr/core
packages.summary: Execution-pack compiler primitives, typed graph builders, deterministic changed-file graph resolution, Contract capsule helpers, and shared Decantr core utilities.

packages.name: @decantr/telemetry
packages.summary: Privacy-preserving telemetry event contracts, clients, and analytics sinks.

packages.name: @decantr/mcp-server
packages.summary: Stable eight-tool MCP surface for content-corpus compatibility, Decantr Contract context, Adoption Truth, bounded Task Capsules, typed graph artifacts, packs, evidence, workspace health, and repair prompts.

packages.name: @decantr/verifier
packages.summary: Shared read-only discovery and verification engine for scan report v2, framework-specific route authority, Adoption Truth v1, bounded Task Capsule v1, Governance Delta v1, default CI report v2, opt-in CI report v3, evidence, project health, and workspace health.

packages.name: @decantr/cli
packages.summary: Workflow commands for content-first setup, authority-aware scan/adopt/task, doctor, verify, CI, codify, connect, and content operations, including Adoption Truth with exact Tailwind v4 source-isolation approvals, bounded Task Capsules, Governance Deltas, default CI v2, opt-in CI v3, monorepo targeting, health baselines, and read-only report-isolated Studio.

packages.name: @decantr/vite-plugin
packages.summary: Experimental Vite-specific overlay for Decantr guard feedback during local development; remains a verification-adjacent sidecar, not a default reliability adapter.

blockers: The Vite overlay remains an opt-in sidecar and is not part of the default Decantr delivery contract.
Decantr still needs an explicit keep-vs-archive decision before this package can move into the supported public surface.
